newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 30.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Ruling Nationalist Party determines to pass revision of anti-gangster rules.
Three places under consideration for storing low nuclear radioactive waste.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Nationwide anti-crime meeting starts today (Monday).
Police urgently search for a Mercedes-Benz that may be related to Taoyuan shooting.
LIBERTY TIMES - Ruling and opposition parties to discuss how to implement conclusions of the National Development Conference.
Ruling Nationalist Party says it wants National Assembly to revise constitution in May or June next year.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan to adopt new permit system for land development.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Ships may be allowed to sail directly across the Taiwan strait in March or April next year.
Relaxation of foreign investment in the stock market lures more foreign funds to the island.
